name: claudex-council
description: Two coding agents, one verdict. Claude routes, Codex responds, you get a synthesized answer — all in a chat panel inside VS Code.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No council sessions open.
[+ New Council Session](command:claudexCouncil.newSession)

Each session is an independent conversation. Open as many as you want — they run in parallel.

claudexCouncil.claudeBinary.description: Path to the Claude Code CLI binary. Leave as 'claude' if it's on PATH.

claudexCouncil.codexHelperPath.description: Absolute path to ask_codex.py. If empty, the extension resolves it from the bundled skill folder.

claudexCouncil.codexBinary.description: Optional path or command name for the Codex CLI. Leave empty to search PATH plus common macOS/Linux/Windows install locations.

claudexCouncil.workingDirectory.description: Working directory for agent invocations. If empty, uses the first workspace folder.

claudexCouncil.pythonBinary.description: Path to python interpreter for the Codex helper. If empty, defaults to 'python3' on macOS/Linux and 'python' on Windows.

claudexCouncil.economyMode.description: Use only the Claude worker per turn (skips Codex worker and the synthesis call). Recommended for users on free-tier accounts who hit quota limits — drops cost to ~30% of normal.

enumDescriptions: Speed/cost profile. Claude worker tools/MCP/skills are disabled; Codex runs read-only with web/MCP/user config disabled.
Capability profile. Claude keeps normal Claude Code tools/MCP/skills/memory context; Codex loads the user's normal Codex config with web/MCP available unless restricted by the sandbox settings below.
claudexCouncil.councilFidelity.description: Capability profile for council turns. Use 'full-fidelity' when you want both agents to keep their native tool/config surface; use 'fast' when latency and cost matter more.

claudexCouncil.coordinatorMode.description: Coordinator behavior for full-council turns. 'local' (default) uses the deterministic router — instant, free, and good enough for the vast majority of routing decisions. 'model' runs a real coordinator model (~25-30s on Opus, ~5-8s on Haiku) for richer routing on complex prompts. Switch to 'model' only if the local router's routing decisions consistently disappoint you.

claudexCouncil.coordinatorModel.description: Claude model used for the coordinator call. Empty = per-session dropdown default. Recommended: claude-sonnet-4-6 for high-quality task decomposition; Haiku is cheaper but weaker for complex coordination.

claudexCouncil.deliberationMode.description: Controls the Claude<->Codex peer-review round before final synthesis. Default 'off' keeps turns fast. Use 'auto' or 'always' only when you want an extra deliberation pass and can tolerate the added latency.

claudexCouncil.smartModelRouting.description: Let the Council choose faster or stronger models per lane when the session is still using default model selections. Explicit dropdown choices are respected.

claudexCouncil.orchestrationVisibility.description: Controls how much internal council work is shown in the chat. 'final-only' shows one unified Council response while hiding coordinator, worker, and review internals; 'answers' shows worker answers and the Council response; 'detailed' shows every internal council bubble.

claudexCouncil.sessionContextMaxChars.description: Maximum characters of prior per-session context injected into coordinator, worker, review, and Council-answer prompts. Includes session metadata, model selections, and recent turn-grouped transcript. The full transcript remains persisted for restore; set 0 to disable prompt context.

claudexCouncil.claudeFullFidelityPermiss.description: Claude Code permission mode used only when councilFidelity is 'full-fidelity'. Set to 'plan' for Claude Plan Mode behavior, or 'bypassPermissions' only in trusted sandboxes.

claudexCouncil.codexFullFidelitySandbox.description: Codex sandbox used only when councilFidelity is 'full-fidelity'. 'inherit' leaves your Codex config/default untouched; 'danger-full-access' gives broader filesystem access.

claudexCouncil.codexFullFidelityBypassAp.description: Only for councilFidelity='full-fidelity': pass Codex's dangerous bypass flag. Use only when the surrounding environment is already trusted.

claudexCouncil.cavemanMode.description: Compression style for Claude worker output. 'auto' enables full Caveman compression only when the caveman skill is installed; synthesis stays normal English.

claudexCouncil.claudeWorkerModel.description: Claude model used for the worker call (the purple bubble). Empty = per-session dropdown default. Common values: sonnet (latest Sonnet alias), opus (latest Opus alias), claude-sonnet-4-6, claude-haiku-4-5. Any model name your claude CLI supports works.

claudexCouncil.codexWorkerModel.description: Codex model used for the worker call (the green bubble). Empty = whatever the Codex CLI picks by default. Common values: gpt-5-codex (default Codex), gpt-5-codex-spark (faster reasoning), gpt-5, o3. Any model name your `codex` CLI supports works.

claudexCouncil.deciderModel.description: Claude or Codex model used for the Council answer synthesis call. Empty = per-session dropdown default. Default is claude-haiku-4-5 for low latency; use claude-sonnet-4-6 when you want stronger but slower synthesis.
